## Premium features included 

Everything you need to coordinate care and keep your family connected.

### Advertisement-Free 

A clean, distraction-free experience so you can focus on what matters most.

### More Villages & Members 

Create multiple villages and invite extended family, friends, and care professionals.

### Calendar Integration 

Sync care schedules with Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook seamlessly.

### Customizable Care Plans 

Create multiple daily and weekly care schedules tailored to your loved one's unique needs.

### Document Management 

Organize medical records, legal documents, and important files in custom folders.

### Wellness Journal Export 

Track and export wellness data to share with healthcare providers at appointments.

## Frequently Asked Questions 

Everything you need to know about our plans.

##### Can I try Caring Village before paying?

Absolutely! Our Free plan gives you full access to basic features with 1 village and up to 2 members. You can upgrade to a premium plan at any time from within the app.

##### How do I choose my plan?

After creating your free account, go to My Subscription in the app. From there you can select and manage your plan. You won't be charged until you choose a paid plan.

##### Can I switch plans later?

Yes! You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time from the My Subscription section in the app.

##### What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and digital payment methods through our secure payment processor.

##### Is my data secure?

Yes. Caring Village uses bank-level encryption and strict privacy controls. Your family's health and caregiving information is never sold or shared with third parties.

## Ready to simplify caregiving? 

Join thousands of families who are already using Caring Village to coordinate care and stay connected.
